text: True or False: In a quantum repeater chain, entanglement swapping improves the fidelity of the distributed entanglement, so no purification step is needed.
explanation: False — fidelity multiplies down the chain, roughly F' = F^2 per swap (two 95% pairs give about 90%), so entanglement degrades with each swap. Entanglement purification (BBPSSW/DEJMPS) is therefore mandatory, trading extra copies and two-way classical communication for higher fidelity.
